page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/README.md#architecture-role-level-comparison-matrix]

#### Architecture Role Level Comparison Matrix

| Aspect                      | Associate EA         | Enterprise Architect | Senior EA             | Principal EA         | Lead EA             |
| --------------------------- | -------------------- | -------------------- | --------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------- |
| **Architecture Experience** | 1-3 years            | 3-7 years            | 7-12 years            | 12+ years            | 15+ years           |
| **Scope**                   | Project components   | Full projects        | Complex projects      | Domain/Portfolio     | Enterprise-wide     |
| **Autonomy**                | Guided supervision   | Independent work     | Technical leadership  | Strategic guidance   | Executive vision    |
| **Decision Level**          | Component design     | Solution design      | Architecture patterns | Standards & policies | Strategic direction |
| **Stakeholders**            | Team members         | Project teams        | Multiple teams        | Business leaders     | C-suite & board     |
| **Complexity**              | Simple components    | Medium solutions     | Complex systems       | Multi-domain         | Enterprise strategy |
| **Mentoring**               | Receiving guidance   | Peer collaboration   | Junior mentoring      | Team development     | Org development     |
| **Documentation**           | Component specs      | Solution docs        | Standards docs        | Governance docs      | Strategy docs       |
| **Meeting Level**           | Project standups     | Design reviews       | Architecture boards   | Steering committees  | Executive meetings  |
| **Budget Impact**           | Task-level           | Project-level        | Program-level         | Portfolio-level      | Enterprise-level    |
| **Risk Mgmt**               | Identify risks       | Assess & mitigate    | Design for risk       | Risk strategy        | Enterprise risk     |
| **Innovation**              | Learn best practices | Apply patterns       | Create patterns       | Define standards     | Set direction       |

page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/README.md#quick-start]

#### Quick Start

1. **Get the template**: Use the [Job Description Template](../../work-templates/assets/artifacts/job-description.md) as your starting point
2. **Rename the file**: Follow the pattern `role-title.md` (e.g., `senior-enterprise-architect.md`)
3. **Replace placeholders**: Fill in all [bracketed placeholders] with actual content
4. **Customize sections**: Adapt sections to the specific role requirements
5. **Review and approve**: Have HR and hiring managers review before publishing
6. **Update this index**: Add your new job description to the relevant section above
page_texts.12:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/README.md#required-customizations]

#### Required Customizations

- **Role Title**: Update throughout the document
- **Reporting Structure**: Define manager and direct reports
- **Responsibilities**: Tailor to specific role requirements
- **Qualifications**: Adjust experience and education requirements
- **Salary Range**: Include appropriate compensation band
- **Contact Information**: Add specific hiring manager details

---
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/README.md#individual-contributor-track]

#### Individual Contributor Track

1. **Associate Enterprise Architect** (Entry Level)

    - 0-3 years experience
    - Focus on learning and supporting senior architects
    - Guided architecture work under supervision

2. **Enterprise Architect** (Mid-Level)

    - 3-7 years experience
    - Independent architecture work on medium complexity projects
    - Domain expertise development

3. **Senior Enterprise Architect** (Senior Level)

    - 7-12 years experience
    - Lead architect on complex projects
    - Mentoring and technical leadership responsibilities

4. **Principal Enterprise Architect** (Principal Level)
    - 12+ years experience
    - Strategic architecture leadership
    - Cross-domain expertise and organizational influence
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/README.md#management-track]

#### Management Track

1. **Architecture Team Lead**

    - Team management responsibilities
    - Project and resource coordination
    - Performance management duties

2. **Architecture Manager**

    - Multiple team management
    - Budget and strategic planning
    - Stakeholder relationship management

3. **Lead Enterprise Architect**
    - Executive leadership role
    - Enterprise-wide architecture strategy
    - Board and C-level engagement
